snippet.title: The Flintstones LiveAction (2026) | Matt Damon, Amanda Seyfried, Jake Gyllenhaal | Concept Trailer
snippet.description:
#theflintstones #concepttrailer #mattdamon

Watch This The Flintstones Live Action Concept Trailer

What if The Flintstones was reimagined as a gritty, grounded prehistoric drama where Bedrock was not a cartoon suburb but a volcanic civilization built on the backs of quarry workers and the man who broke the most rock had the least to show for it? This fan-made concept trailer imagines The Flintstones for 2026 where Matt Damon stars as Fred Flintstone, a quarry foreman who has spent his life cutting stone for a city he can barely afford to live in, alongside Jake Gyllenhaal as his best friend Barney Rubble, the one man Fred trusts with his life. I personally created every storyboard and visual in this "What If" concept from scratch, building a cinematic reimagining where a catastrophic quarry collapse exposes a rare mineral vein beneath the volcanic ridge and Anthony Hopkins as Mr. Slate, the ruthless owner of Slate Rock and Gravel Company, seizes the discovery and announces a brutal expansion that will displace entire families from their homes. When Slate frames Barney for the collapse and locks him away to silence any resistance, Fred is forced to choose between keeping his family safe or fighting the most powerful man in Bedrock.

Amanda Seyfried plays Wilma Flintstone, the quiet backbone of the resistance who organizes the displaced families into a united front while Fred rallies the quarry workers to blockade the gates and demand what is owed to the people who built this city with their bare hands. Natalie Portman delivers a fierce turn as Betty Rubble, who infiltrates the quarry district alone at night to break her husband free from Slate's holding cell because no wall in Bedrock was ever built strong enough to keep her from the man she loves. Every visual in this HD concept trailer was designed and built by me to transform The Flintstones into a story of stone, sacrifice, and survival where the volcanic ridge beneath Bedrock begins to crack and erupt as the quarry destabilizes the very ground the city was built upon, fire rains from the sky, the earth splits open, and Fred must lead his people out of the collapsing settlement while Slate watches the empire he carved sink into its own pit. This Flintstones live action concept trailer proves that Fred's war cry was never a punchline but a battle cry for every man who ever broke his back building someone else's world.

Disclaimer: This is entirely a fan-made concept trailer created for entertainment and creative purposes only. All storyboard work and visuals were originally created by me. This video is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Warner Bros., Hanna-Barbera, or any official Flintstones production or its rights holders.

snippet.title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 - Official Snakes Saga Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Snakes Saga Trailer for Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2, the upcoming sequel remastered collection developed by Konami. Players can take a trip down memory lane that all began with Operation Snake Eater during Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater. Snake's story leads into the two additions of the Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 with the Peace Walker Project in Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and The Guns of the Patriot Incident in Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots. Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 is launching August 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

snippet.description:

https://gruporecluta.lnk.to/CirculoCerrado

Sigue a Grupo Recluta: 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gruporecluta

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/GrupoReclutaOfficial
Twitter: https://twitter.com/musicrecluta
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/2Dlvgi70UoJJicfKgoW5Vo

Letra : 

Que e sido un poco diferente al resto
siempre he tratado de ser muy honesto
me encuentro construyendo los cimientos para ser mejor

si me aleje no fue por ser grosero
entendí que la familia es primero
si se ofendieron me disculpan
pero por favor

ya dejen de andar llevando y trayendo
les faltan huevos a lo que estoy viendo 
por suerte me di cuenta a tiempo 
que el amigo era yo

no se preocupen siéntanse tranquilos
yo no soy bueno pa hacer enemigos
solo le pido a Dios que sus deseos
los multiplique por dos
 
Hoooy 
Hoooy
con circulo cerrado
Me he enfocado en ser mejor

Música

el hambre es perra y mas el que la aguante
y de mi vida yo cargo el volante
voy manejando puro pa adelante
sin ver el retrovisor

la caca flota siempre se ha sabido
y descubrí que no eran tan amigos
hablando mal de mi siempre a la espalda
la envidia se los comió

ya dejen de andar llevando y trayendo
no me interesa lo que anden diciendo 
pero se bien que ustedes necesitan 
ser el centro de atención 

no se preocupen siéntanse tranquilos
si no ya saben se sientan conmigo
aquí lo anoto en las cosas que me valieron
verga y por favor
 
No oh oh
no no no
Nunca muerdan la mano
que tanto les ayudo

snippet.title: Billy Strings - Mill Town Flood (Official Video)
snippet.description:
Billy Strings new album 'So Much For Goodbyes' arrives August 28: https://billystrings.lnk.to/somuchforgoodbyes

The vintage postcards and historical images featured in this video are drawn from the private collection of Billy Strings. Portions of this collection include materials generously shared with him by the Village of Muir, MI.

"Mill Town Flood"
Written by Billy Strings (Apostol Publishing, BMI; administered by: Songs of Tuckaway Music, BMI and Sony Tree Publishing), Daniel Tashian (Royal Peach Publishing, BMI), and P.J. George III (Philip George Music, BMI)

LYRICS
Well my name is Darwin Lyin 
And I work on the Grand Trunk line
Movin’ lumber down at the Muir Station
Keeping all of the engines on time
 
I work for Mr. Blanchard
Though I never met the man
I take his honest wages 
And I come home with two tired hands
 
And it looks like it's raining
For the third time today
And I pray it keeps coming down
Till’ the river
Takes me away
 
She was standing on the platform
With a postcard in her hand
Even though my shy heart was racing
I inquired did she have a man
 
She looked down at the walkway
And the wind danced in her hair
She told me she was a widow
As she whispered a silent prayer
 
And it looks like it's raining
For the third time today
And I pray it keeps coming down
Till the river 
Takes me away
 
I would court her through the autumn
Till’ finally she would agree
We were married down on the Maple River
Neath’ the shade of the old redbud tree
 
Most days I spent at the parlor
And the drink got the best part of me
Till’ I stumbled alone to the home that we made
Just to find she decided to leave
 
Now I lay here in this gutter
While the poison rushes my veins
And I curse this god forsaken fever
That could drive any poor man insane
 
And it looks like it's raining
For the third time today
And I pray it keeps coming down
Till the river 
Takes me away

Royal Masat: Bass
Bryan Sutton: Guitar
Daniel Tashian: Guitar, Backing Vocals
Lindsay Lou: Backing Vocals
PJ George III: Harmonium

snippet.title: Tony Iommi – World Alone (Official Video)
snippet.description:
#tonyiommi #worldalone #fromthedark
Pre-order From The Dark here : https://tonyiommi.lnk.to/fromthedarkyv 

0:00 - 1:50 - Prelude
1:51 – 6:00 - World Alone
6:01 – 7:24 - Credits

Tony Iommi - Guitar
Jorn Lande - Vocals & Lyrics
Karl Brazil - Drums
Becky Baldwin - Bass
Mike Exeter – Keyboards

Written & Directed by Ryan Mackfall @ryancrashburn
Produced by Myskatonic.co @myskatonicfilms
Executive Producers – Tony Iommi, Ralph Baker, Ben Baker & Miles Hackett
'The Believer' played by Darcy Vanhinsbergh

Music Produced by Tony Iommi & Mike Exeter
Music Mixed by Mike Exeter and Andy Sneap

Film Art Direction & Production Design – Lee Evans & Alex Rose
Director Of Photography – Sam Breeze
Gaffer – John Crooks
Editor – John John Phillips
VFX Artist – Nadav Rotem
First Assistant Director – Steve Crabtree

Unit Manager – Edward Ellis-Smith
Line Producer – Kingsley Marschall
Costume Designer – Tasha Middleton
Jorn Shoot Cinematographer – Ben Mills
Focus Puller/First AC – Lily Coney
Loader/Second AC – Jacca Cock
Lighting Trainee – Maddie Hart
Stills Photographers – Isaac Wilson & Brian Robinson
BTS Cameraman & Editor – Jake Potter BFE
Standby Props – Logan Harvey
Scenic Artist – Logan ‘Steamy’ Clark
Make-Up – Juliana Ratcliff
Production Assistants – Jessie Horry, Filip Kolasny & Naomi McGivern
Craft Services – Wellington Catering Co
Post-Production Colour – Ink
Colour Producer – Grace Tomlinson
Colourist – Katie Dymmock
Assistant Colourist – Nicole Angliss
Sound Designer – John John Phillips
DIT – Jake Potter BFE
Crew, Camera & Editing Facilities provided by Crashburn.co

Follow Tony Iommi :
Website : https://www.iommi.com/ 
Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/tonyiomm/ 
X : https://x.com/tonyiommi 
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/tonyiommi/ 
YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/@tonyiommiofficial 
Spotify : https://open.spotify.com/artist/7iA7uWUkWLpapsaaqmzRQV 
Apple Music : https://music.apple.com/us/artist/tony-iommi/462585 

LYRICS

Hey Stranger, you run into the wall
Black shadow rises looming over your life
But you hold on to save the light that shines your hall
Your prison cell it’s just a spell to make you fall

In the waters that you helm, the siren of the heart
Tyrants of the dawning can steal your sun
From the shatter of the quake, inner blackness you unfurl
To burn it with your fire screaming you restore your world alone

Above danger, losing ground as time reloads
Man and machine with the soul between it flies with the heavy load
The liar will shout and drag you straight to hell
Wedlocked in a game that kills, fighting one-man wars

On the waters of your realm, dancing serpents in the dark
Diving without warning, aiming for the heart
As you’re laying out your bait
You pull the trigger as they swirl
You know you never needed no one to face the world alone

Devil spawn to your deathblow, evil will burn

In the waters of your well, life is on the rise
Children to the morning where no one feels
Running wired from the wait, revolution giving birth
They never needed anyone to change the world alone
